value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks cooler. Expect partly sunny skies and a high around 65°F, about 15 degrees cooler than today. Rain or showers could roll in Tuesday evening, with about a 30% chance after 3 p.m. Overnight it drops into the low 40s and 30s. Bring a jacket.
